title: Photo Studio Interior Design 130 m² | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 130 m² photo studio: interior design, custom furniture, turnkey renovation and design supervision. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Photo studio interior design and custom furniture, 130 m²

blocks.text: Photo studio interior design and custom furniture, 130 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) designed and delivered a 130 m² photo studio project, including a turnkey renovation with design supervision and the design of custom furniture.

The photo studio is organized around a variety of professional shooting scenarios and a comfortable workflow for the team. The project includes a corridor, a reception area, a wardrobe room, a prep and makeup area, a themed Barbie room, a cyclorama room, and a loft zone with several photo sets.
The main goal was to fit several distinctly different sets for photo and video shoots into 130 m², with zoning and lighting organized around them.

Custom furniture was designed for the project, including a reception desk with wall panels, makeup tables, cabinets, drawer units, shelves, a bed, and other interior elements. The furniture was designed alongside the interior, which made it possible to preserve a unified concept and make efficient use of the space.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs photo studios, beauty salons, offices, stores, and showrooms in Bratislava and Vienna — from concept and technical documentation to custom furniture and turnkey renovation.
